packageRules.description: @types/node tracks engines.node, not the newest LTS. Typechecking against 24's lib accepts APIs absent on the >=22.19.0 floor this package claims. Raise this ceiling in the same commit that raises engines.

peerDependency ranges ship in package.json. Widening one is a deliberate act: bump it, re-run the integration suite, type it feat: or fix: (CONTRIBUTING). The >= ranges mean Renovate skips them today anyway - this makes that structural instead of incidental.
